On June 3, 2026, four years after 30-year-old Krystal Anderson disappeared, authorities announced that her remains have been identified.

Dateline first covered Krystal’s case in September 2022, a month after she vanished, and spoke with her sister, Shadira Smothers.

Shadira told Dateline that on Tuesday, August 23, she received a concerning phone call from the father of one of Krystal’s children. He said Krystal had failed to pick up their son from his house that Sunday and that he had not heard from her.

Shadira said Krystal would never miss a scheduled pickup of her children, so she immediately became worried.

She told Dateline that she called Krystal’s live-in boyfriend, Tony Berry, who said he had not seen Krystal since 1:00 a.m. on Saturday.

According to a police report provided to Dateline by the Aiken County Sheriff’s Office, deputies responded to a missing person report on August 24 and spoke with Krystal’s mother, Wanda Sumpter.

Wanda told deputies that it was “very irregular behavior” for Krystal to disappear and that she normally communicated with Wanda or other family members on a daily basis. The report also states that Wanda was “very concerned due to past history of violence with Krystal and her boyfriend, Tony Berry.” Prior to his arrest in 2022, Dateline reached out to Berry for comment on Krystal’s disappearance, but calls went straight to voicemail.

On September 28, 2022, the Aiken County Sheriff’s Office announced in a press release that the last time Krystal was seen, “it was believed that [she] was in the company of Tony Lee Berry at her home on Seivern Road in Wagener.” The release added that “results in this investigation ha[d] led investigators to obtaining an arrest warrant for Berry in relation to the disappearance of Krystal.”

Berry was arrested and taken into custody on September 28 and charged with kidnapping. A few months later, on December 13, he was also charged with murder. He has pleaded not guilty.

According to the arrest warrant provided to Dateline at the time by the Aiken County Sheriff’s Office, investigators believe Berry “took the life of Krystal Anderson.” The warrant stated that on August 20, 2022, witnesses saw Berry in a verbal altercation withKrystal and later saw him place her into the trunk of his 2007 Cadillac CTS. The warrant also said that the vehicle was later found burned in Newberry County, South Carolina. The warrant goes on to say that based on cell phone records, investigators believed Berry was in the area around the same time the vehicle was set on fire. According to the warrant, Berry also allegedly purchased “numerous items that could be used to aid in the disposal of human remains,” including a shovel, plastic coveralls, gloves, and a box of trash bags. It further stated that “Berry researched how to carry out this crime and leave no evidence.”

At the time, Krystal’s body had not been found. That changed in May 2026.

According to WAGT, on May 13, acting on information they had received, Aiken County deputies discovered human remains buried off Highway 37 near Blackville, South Carolina, less than an hour from Krystal’s home in Aiken County.

On June 3, the Aiken County Coroner’s Office announced in a press release that the remains discovered in a “clandestine grave in a remote area of Barnwell County” had been transported to the coroner’s office for testing, and were later positively identified as Krystal Anderson.

Berry remains in custody at the Aiken County Jail. He was expected to stand trial in May, but the proceedings were delayed. His next court date is set for July.

Anyone with information is asked to contact the Aiken County Sheriff’s Office at 803-642-1761.
